notes: Panel Editor reorganized: the old Settings tab (everything from the clock to weather to power buttons) is split into Content, Sensors, Date / Time, Weather, Shortcuts, Media, and Computer — Settings now holds only the border toggle.

New Content tab: a flat checklist of everything the panel can show, each with a Configure button that jumps straight to where it's set up. Turn something off here and its tab disappears from the sidebar until it's back on.
New Sensors tab: per-component show/hide (CPU, GPU, iGPU, Memory, Storage, Laptop, Network, Frame) — hides that component from the panel in both Sensor Layout modes.
"Show title" moved to Portal; "Layout type" (Dense/Relaxed/Minimal) moved to the Layout tab.
